title: Post-reset intent with masked history
description: One 5 Hz intent produced immediately after a participant reset at Expert difficulty. reset_generation has advanced to 2, matching the referenced observation obs.t000800.ai_classic_4, history_valid is 0 (pass/occupancy/contact history is masked to zero/defaults, mirroring the observation contract), and post_reset_defaults_applied records which fields reverted. The intent itself is the safe waiting case: recentered lateral target, mid pace, follow commitment, retained drift preference. The exact default numeric values are authored placeholders, not specified values; see unknowns. The 10 m section is the one the referenced observation obs.t000800.ai_classic_4 describes (10 m road width at all three lookaheads, usable half-width 5.0 m), so the legal corridor half-width is (10.0 - 1.8)/2 - 0.5 m = 3.6 m.

lateral.note: Recenter default after reset; 0.0 x 3.6 m = 0.0 m.

commitment.label: follow
commitment.note: -0.6 is below -1/3, so the label is follow.

drift.label: retain
drift.note: Between the drift thresholds; with masked history there is no prior preference, so retain is the neutral label.

reset.note: History is masked to zero/defaults after the reset; timers and counters are restored.

expectations.statement: With post_reset_defaults_applied true, history_valid is 0 and reset_generation is at least 1.
The recentered target decodes to 0.0 m inside the corridor.
commitment_raw -0.6 is below -1/3, so the label is follow; drift_raw 0.0 is retain.
Expert difficulty uses the 7-tick delayed traffic snapshot.
Record difficulty, style, producer kind and revision match the fixture context.
Even after a reset, hazard checks are never deferred.
Every declared metric is a documented initial target or an explicit undecided requirement; no fixture metric claims a measured status.
Each metric's bound members match its comparator: threshold comparators carry value, range/ratio_range carry ordered value_min/value_max, report carries no bound.
Every null that means 'not yet determined' has a matching unknowns entry.

comparison.purpose: Document the reset-related semantics a correct implementation must preserve, plus the standing intervention targets.

metrics.name: emergency_replacements_fraction
metrics.description: Emergency safety substitutions per proposed 5 Hz intent.

metrics.name: material_corrections_fraction
metrics.description: Material road/collision corrections per proposed 5 Hz intent, material per BENCHMARKS.md.

unknowns.reason: The exact post-reset default intent values (lateral recenter to 0, conservative pace 0.4, follow) are authored placeholders; OPPONENT_AI.md specifies only zero/masked reset history defaults, not default intent values.
The expert desired speed-profile interval is tuned at M4.3 and is not numerically specified.
Target speed cannot be decoded until the difficulty interval is ratified.
The short anti-jitter commitment window length is not numerically specified.
The interpolation curve is not specified.
Placeholder only: no Classic planner revision exists until M4.2 implements the shared interface.
Required behavior for a stale intent (at or beyond 12 ticks) is not specified.
